# The Windows key as the conversion key, at a command prompt whose prompt is ">"
# (opened as for console.txt). If a tap opened the Start menu, the window would
# lose the keyboard focus and the check would stop there. Nothing is entered:
# the line is cleared with Esc at the end.
tap-key:win
layout:en
wait:800
type:ghbdtn
tap:win
wait:600
contains:>привет
expect-layout:ru
type:\sghbdtn
contains:>привет привет
tap:win
wait:600
contains:>привет ghbdtn
expect-layout:en
key:esc
